purpose: Manual review scenarios for prepare-implementation; expected behavior, not recorded model results.
execution: No harness/model runs performed. Review routing and artifact contents manually; do not infer behavioral accuracy from static validation.

scenarios.context: Trusted runtime identifies the active harness as Codex. The user-level policy is tool-neutral. Both CLIs are installed.
scenarios.request: Prepare implementation from the approved search PRD.
expected: Select markdown-checklist without asking
Read only markdown-checklist.md
Generate project PLAN.md with unchecked stories and criteria

scenarios.context: Trusted runtime identifies the active harness as OpenCode. The user-level policy is tool-neutral. Both CLIs are installed.
scenarios.request: Prepare implementation from the approved search PRD.
expected: Select ralph-json without asking

Preserve exact Ralph keys, types, ordering, false passes and typecheck criteria

scenarios.request: Create plan.json for later use with OpenCode Ralph.
expected: Explicit request wins: ralph-json
Read only ralph-format.md
Prepare JSON without execution
prohibited: Reject conversion because Codex is active

scenarios.request: Write a Markdown user-story checklist in PLAN.md instead of JSON.
expected: Explicit request wins: markdown-checklist

expected: Ask for target or format before loading either reference

scenarios.context: No authoritative runtime instruction; neither CLI is installed.
scenarios.request: Prepare implementation.
expected: Ask for target or format before loading either reference
prohibited: Choose a default from absent binaries

scenarios.context: Active Codex markdown-checklist default.
scenarios.request: Create only PLAN.md as Markdown and only Ralph JSON as the same artifact.
expected: Clarify the conflicting explicit formats before writing
prohibited: Silently resolve conflict using runtime default

scenarios.context: Codex default. PLAN.md contains checked US-001 with verification evidence and unrelated scope.
scenarios.request: Prepare a plan for a different feature.
expected: Preserve existing plan
Preview and require confirmation before destructive replacement or reset

scenarios.context: Codex default. Existing PLAN.md has checked US-001 with evidence and pending US-002.
scenarios.request: Continue this approved plan: refine only US-002 criteria; keep completed work.
expected: Update only approved scoped sections
Preserve checked US-001 and its evidence
Keep new criteria unchecked
prohibited: Claim newly generated work passed tests

scenarios.context: OpenCode default. Existing plan.json is for another feature with progress.txt and memory.json.
scenarios.request: Convert this new PRD.
expected: Follow unchanged Ralph reference
Preview replacement, archive and reset and require confirmation
Preserve memory.json absent separate reset approval

scenarios.context: Codex default. Approved PRD needs twelve bounded stories; no project typecheck command exists.
scenarios.request: Prepare the checklist for /goal.
expected: Unique IDs, ordered priorities, prior-only acyclic dependencies
Research, implementation, verification, mode-aware staged review, remediation and authorized story commit
Embed installed-skill loading for story-execution.md and story-review.md
Append execution status and evidence to progress.txt; bounded validated review knowledge in memory.json
Keep PLAN.md limited to the plan and completion checkboxes
Record unavailable typecheck honestly as a blocker if required
Require an exact prepared branch before execution
Offer explicit execution and story-commit launch authorization; do not execute it
prohibited: Create or reset progress.txt or memory.json during planning
Claim Codex enforces Ralph's hard iteration limit

scenarios.context: No runtime default; CLI presence unknown.
scenarios.request: Prepare this PRD for OpenCode Ralph.
expected: Select ralph-json from explicit target without asking
Load only ralph-format.md

scenarios.context: Codex default. Approved Python client story recommends python-pro for implementation and code-reviewer for review.
scenarios.request: Prepare the Markdown checklist, preserving the recommended specialists.
expected: Preserve supplied recommendations as optional context, but fix the native staged gate to story-reviewer
Implementation specialists provide read-only advice under the shared budget; executor owns edits and tests
Start delegation evidence pending and check runtime availability during execution
prohibited: Spawn agents to implement during planning
Make the implementation agent its own independent reviewer
Claim a listed agent was invoked

scenarios.context: Codex default. Approved small documentation story has no recommended agents.
scenarios.request: Prepare the checklist without unnecessary delegation.
expected: Allow primary-agent implementation
Recommend advisors only when useful within the mode budget
Use shared mode-aware self/native review rules rather than requiring independent review for every trivial story
prohibited: Force a specialist for trivial implementation
Omit review because no specialist was recommended

scenarios.context: Codex default. The PRD recommends python-pro, but its runtime availability is unknown.
scenarios.request: Prepare the implementation checklist; do not execute it.
expected: Preserve the supplied recommendation
Require native availability checking before execution
Record any later skipped recommendation and reason; do not silently substitute for an explicitly required agent
prohibited: Claim the role is callable because its definition exists

scenarios.request: Prepare this approved feature.
expected: Select ralph-json from the native entry point without asking
Load only ralph-format.md
Generate the plan without starting execution

Probe PATH to identify the runtime

scenarios.request: Refine only US-002's implementation plan; do not execute it.
expected: Read relevant progress context and preserve pending approvals
Update only scoped plan content
Preserve progress.txt unchanged during planning

expected: Preserve existing plan evidence and completion checkboxes
Direct future execution notes to progress.txt
Require explicit cleanup approval before relocating old notes

prohibited: Treat the convention change as execution or commit approval

scenarios.request: Complete the current story.
expected: Stop with the exact native reviewer blocker
Append safe progress checkpoint and leave story pending

scenarios.context: PLAN.md requires feat/search; current branch is main, detached, or a different feature branch.
scenarios.request: Execute the plan and commit each passing story.
expected: Reject before file changes including logs
Report exact branch blocker

scenarios.context: Checks and staged review passed; provisional story checkbox staged; authorized commit fails its hook.
scenarios.request: Finalize the story.
expected: Restore only provisional marker in worktree/index where authorized
Append failed-commit checkpoint without rewriting history

scenarios.context: Native story-reviewer returns truncated JSON or blocked verdict; initial pass has ended.
scenarios.request: Complete this story.
expected: Fail closed and leave pending
Record protocol blocker
Do not spend targeted pass repairing failed protocol
prohibited: Treat empty findings as passing despite invalid verdict

scenarios.request: Finish review and finalize the story.
expected: Resume actual initial reviewer ID for at most one targeted pass
Promote reusable accepted_fixed evidence only after passing review
Deduplicate memory and keep bounds of 20 patterns and 20 suppressions
Commit only under explicit story-commit scope
